principle: Audio controls timing and envelopes; continuity controls anatomy and shape.
guards: Do not infer body size, sex, age or identity from vocal frequency.
Do not alter established proportions from acoustic features alone.
Use relative within-recording normalization rather than universal male frequency thresholds.
Require an explicit scene binding before applying a vocal event to a character.
Retain source file, sample offset and analysis parameters for every event.

pitch_glide.motion: follow measured pitch trajectory with eased interpolation

pulsed_resonance.motion: use measured amplitude pulses as bounded repeated motion

irregular_resonance.motion: apply restrained nonuniform vibration without changing silhouette

sustained_resonance.motion: maintain a stable held pose with subtle amplitude modulation

gesture_policy: Gesture labels are acoustic heuristics. Use them as motion hints only; do not infer emotion, intent, identity, anatomy, or body scale.
